mapper.select: SELECT v.id AS versionId, v.version_no AS versionNo, w.workflow_name AS workflowName, w.project_id AS projectId FROM workflow w JOIN workflow_version v ON v.workflow_id = w.id AND v.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND v.deleted = false WHERE w.id = #{workflowId} AND w.deleted = false AND ((#{versionId} IS NULL AND v.id = w.current_version_id) OR v.id = #{versionId}) LIMIT 1
SELECT q.id FROM queue q JOIN queue_project_scope s ON s.queue_id = q.id WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} AND q.status = 'ENABLED' AND q.deleted = false LIMIT 1
